promise_assessment_scores_range.name: promise_assessment_scores_range
promise_assessment_scores_range.value:
"promise_assessment"."specificity_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND "promise_assessment"."measurability_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND "promise_assessment"."deadline_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND "promise_assessment"."jurisdiction_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
        AND "promise_assessment"."outcome_definition_score" BETWEEN 0 AND 5

promise_assessment_published_is_reviewed.name: promise_assessment_published_is_reviewed
promise_assessment_published_is_reviewed.value: "promise_assessment"."workflow_state" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("promise_assessment"."reviewed_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "promise_assessment"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

coalition_mapping_verified_has_reviewer.name: coalition_mapping_verified_has_reviewer
coalition_mapping_verified_has_reviewer.value: "coalition_promise_mapping"."human_verified" = false OR ("coalition_promise_mapping"."verified_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "coalition_promise_mapping"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)

promise_evidence_verified_has_reviewer.name: promise_evidence_verified_has_reviewer
promise_evidence_verified_has_reviewer.value: "promise_evidence"."human_verified" = false OR ("promise_evidence"."verified_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "promise_evidence"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
